# ssp_feature (Data Source)

Reads the current deployment status of a vDefend feature on the SSP platform.

Corresponds to `GET /ssp/lcm/features/{feature}/status`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `feature` (String) Name of the feature to query (case-sensitive, e.g. `INTELLIGENCE`).

### Read-Only

- `deployment_status` (String) Detailed deployment status from the deployment results object.
- `overall_progress` (Number) Overall deployment progress as a percentage (0–100).
- `overall_status` (String) Current overall deployment status (e.g. `DEPLOYMENT_SUCCESSFUL`, `NOT_DEPLOYED`).
- `precheck_status` (String) Overall status of the most recent pre-check run.
